text: あの…　エリカ　かわいい　でしょ　カスミも　いいよね！

structure.jp: エリカ　かわいい　でしょ
カスミも　いいよね！

patterns.name: 〜でしょう
patterns.explanation: でしょ is a short, casual でしょう. It asks the listener to agree with what you just said. かわいい　でしょ = 'she's cute, isn't she?'

patterns.name: 〜よね
patterns.explanation: よね at the end says what you think and checks that the listener thinks the same. いいよね = 'she's nice, right?'
